name: playwright-lite-mcp
description: Token-efficient Magento / Adobe Commerce QA: guest checkout, full page cache, price and stock, GraphQL and page health checks in one call each, plus Playwright code mode. Ships the MCP server (Docker) and a QA playbook skill.

allowed_origins.title: Allowed store origins
allowed_origins.description: Comma-separated origins the browser may open, e.g. https://staging.example.com,https://*.example.com

allow_scripts.title: Code mode (browser_run)
allow_scripts.description: Enable browser_run: the agent's Playwright scripts run inside the container. Recommended, it saves the most tokens on multi-page work.

local_store_host.title: Local store hostname
local_store_host.description: Hostname of a store running on this machine (Warden, DDEV, Valet), e.g. app.mystore.test: the container resolves it to the host. Keep the default for remote stores.

ignore_https_errors.title: Ignore HTTPS errors
ignore_https_errors.description: Accept self-signed certificates: needed for local dev stores, whose CA the container does not trust. Never for real sites.
